name: Milo Quifes
bio: Milo Quifes (born 14 October 2001) is a Spanish actor and writer. In 2024, he published Ultravioleta, his first novel, a romantic fiction about two men. Quifes is primarily known for his role as Carlos in La Bola Negra (2026). Prior to the film, Quifes had no formal acting training or professional screen experience, originally attending the open casting call thinking he was only auditioning to be an extra.

credits.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
credits.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
